summary.text: Steve Jacob, listed by Ballotpedia as Steven Jacob, is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is the sitting Republican state representative for Minnesota House District 20B, a farmer and small business owner who served on the Winona County Commission before entering the House.

paragraphs.text: Steven Jacob was born in Minnesota and earned a high school diploma from Plainview High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a fourth-generation family farmer, married to his wife Mary for 38 years, with four children and five grandchildren.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as farmer and small business owner, and says that as of 2024 he was affiliated with Farm Bureau.
Jacob served 10 years as a Winona County Commissioner before his election to the Minnesota House in 2022, according to his Ballotpedia survey answers.
In that survey he said he reduced the number of county employees from 340 to 260 and led an effort to sell the county government center.
He won Minnesota House District 20B in 2022, defeating Elise Diesslin with 66.1 percent of the vote, and was re-elected in 2024, defeating Michael Hutchinson with 66.9 percent.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning on January 3, 2023, and says he is not running for re-election to the House in 2026.

In 2025-2026 Jacob was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy, Human Services Finance and Policy, Rules and Legislative Administration, and Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy committees.
He won the August 11, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 20, defeating Theodore Kimble with 83.4 percent of the vote, and faces Democrat Jason Lohmann in the general election.

In his 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Jacob said his priorities include agriculture, the environment and the Legislative Audit Commission's work on government fraud, and that his goal is to downsize government and defend the taxpayer.
